PCP.Config.Title: Panel title
PCP.Config.PortraitSizeHint: 32–320 px. Characters can override this size.
PCP.Config.FreePositionHint: You can also move the bar by right-clicking the handle in its corner and choosing “Move bar”.
PCP.Config.GeneralHelp: Offsets are measured from the selected corner. This module does not depend on user assignment: a player may control several characters and all of them can be displayed.
PCP.Config.AppearanceHelp: Choose “No frame” together with “Transparent” to blend transparent PNGs into the scene. Per-character overrides are available in the Characters tab and in the right-click menu.
PCP.Config.BarsHelp: Each bar reads a sheet field. Pick the value path from the suggestions, e.g. system.attributes.hp.value. The «fixed maximum» is used when the maximum path is empty or invalid. «Automatic» colours the bar green to red by percentage.
PCP.Config.FieldsHelp: Show extra sheet values as small chips under the name (AC, level, stress, etc.). Empty values are hidden automatically.
PCP.Config.PathsHelp: Paths are resolved inside the actor. The system. prefix is optional, so attributes.hp.value also works.
PCP.Config.PlayersEnabledHint: Optional. Shows its own list in the corner you choose, with a context menu. When off, Foundry's list stays where it is.
PCP.Config.HideCorePlayersHint: Only applies while the replacement list is on.
PCP.Config.PlayersHelp: Click or right-click a player name to open its menu. Players get their own actions there: open their sheet, choose their character, whisper the GM and local display preferences.
PCP.Config.CharactersHelp: Select the actors displayed in the party bar. Lower order numbers appear first. The player label is filled automatically from actor ownership; set it to override it.
PCP.Config.FooterHint: Tip: right-click a portrait, the bar handle or a player name for quick actions.
PCP.Menu.Hud.Title: Party bar
PCP.Menu.User.ShowInBar: Show / hide in the party bar
PCP.Menu.User.RequestBar: Ask the GM to show my character
PCP.Move.Hint: Drag the bar · release to fix it · Esc cancels
PCP.Players.Title: Players
PCP.Framing.Title: Adjust portrait framing
PCP.Framing.Hint: Drag the image to frame it. Use the mouse wheel to zoom. Double-click to reset.
PCP.Prompt.CustomSize.Label: Size in pixels ({min}–{max})
PCP.Prompt.Whisper.Title: Whisper to {name}
PCP.Prompt.WhisperGM.Title: Whisper to the GM
PCP.Prompt.Kick.Title: Kick player
PCP.Prompt.RequestBar.Message: {user} asks the GM to show {actor} in the party bar.
PCP.Notifications.NoPermission: You do not have permission to view that sheet.
PCP.Notifications.NoCharacter: That player has no assigned character.
PCP.Notifications.NoGM: There is no active GM to whisper to.
PCP.Notifications.KickFailed: The player could not be kicked.
PCP.Notifications.CharacterChangeFailed: The character could not be assigned to that user.
PCP.Notifications.UserConfigFailed: The user configuration could not be opened.
PCP.Settings.Config.Name: Party Corner Portraits + configuration
PCP.Settings.Client.Name: Party Corner Portraits + local preferences
PCP.Settings.Client.Hint: Local visibility, scale and display preferences.
PCP.Settings.Menu.Name: Party Corner Portraits +
PCP.Settings.Menu.Label: Configure party portraits
PCP.Settings.Menu.Hint: Choose the party, portrait data, bars, position and player list replacement.
PCP.A11y.Title: Accessibility
PCP.A11y.TextSizeHint: Enlarges names, bars, menus and the module's windows.
PCP.A11y.ContrastHint: Pure white text, strong borders and solid black backgrounds.
PCP.A11y.LegibleHint: Wider letter spacing and clear letter shapes.
PCP.A11y.Note: These settings only apply to this browser; they do not change what others see.
PCP.Config.AvoidHint: The list steps aside from Foundry's scene controls and sidebar so it never covers them.
PCP.Config.HotbarHint: Visible, fully hidden or shown when the cursor gets close. Applies to every player.
PCP.Config.HidePlayersHint: Same as the macro bar. If you leave it visible it does not move.
PCP.Visibility.Hover: Show when the cursor is near
PCP.Config.MediaPlaceholder: Image, GIF or looping video (webm, mp4)
PCP.Config.HotbarOverlap: If the macro bar covers the portraits
PCP.Config.HotbarOverlapHint: Move it aside, or show it in front, semi-transparent.
PCP.Config.SourceHint: In Foundry these are different things: the portrait is the sheet image and the token is the map figure. Each character can override it.
PCP.Hover.Title: When the cursor rests on a portrait
PCP.Hover.EnabledHint: Rest the cursor on a portrait in the bar and it shows large, like Image Hover.
PCP.Hover.SourceHint: Each character can override it, even with its own file.
PCP.Hover.DelayHint: Time the cursor must rest on the portrait.
PCP.Hover.SizeHint: Longest side of the image, in pixels. It never exceeds the screen.
PCP.Hover.Caption: Show the name below
PCP.Hover.PermissionHint: The GM always sees it. Each player can also turn it off for themselves from the portrait menu.
PCP.Hover.SharedHint: The GM can show the image to everyone with right-click on the portrait → «Show to everyone».
PCP.Hover.Help: With the keyboard, the image appears when the portrait is focused with Tab. With «Reduce motion», video stays on its first frame.
PCP.Menu.Actor.HoverPick: Choose a file for the enlarged view…
PCP.Studio.Title: Portrait studio
PCP.Studio.GMOnly: Only the GM can use the portrait studio.
PCP.Studio.NoSelection: Pick one or more characters from the bar. Controls act live and save when released.
PCP.Studio.SizeHint: Drag and see it instantly. Global:
PCP.Studio.SizeDownHint: Shrinks 10 % keeping the differences between portraits.
PCP.Studio.SizeUpHint: Grows 10 % keeping the differences between portraits.
PCP.Studio.UseGlobalHint: Removes the own size: they go back to the bar's global size.
PCP.Studio.EqualizeHint: Sets every portrait in the bar to the size above.
PCP.Studio.RotationHint: Rotates the image inside its frame.
PCP.Studio.FramingHint: Centers the image, zoom ×1 and rotation 0.
PCP.Studio.HaloHint: Light around the silhouette. At 0 it is removed.
PCP.Studio.HaloSoftHint: From crisp band to diffuse light.
PCP.Studio.HaloPulseHint: The halo beats. Stops with «Reduce motion».
PCP.Studio.CountdownHint: A number on the portrait; it counts down as combat advances.
PCP.Studio.SavePresetHint: Saves the look of the first selected character.
PCP.Studio.FocusHint: Dims the other portraits (your screen only).
PCP.Studio.SpotlightHint: Focus with a ring around the selection.
PCP.Studio.CopyHint: Copies the look (size, transparency, halo, rotation), not the character.
PCP.Studio.OriginalHint: Returns the selection to the default look: no own size, halo, rotation or countdown.
PCP.Hover.BoxHint: By default the image shows with no frame or background. Turn it on for a box behind it.
PCP.Hover.MoveHint: Drag the image · release to fix it · Esc cancels
PCP.Hover.MoveSaved: Enlarged image position saved. It will appear there for every character.
PCP.Hover.NoCharacters: There are no characters in the bar to show as a sample.
PCP.Hover.SizeLabel: Longest side in pixels (120–1200). Applies to every character.
PCP.Hover.PlacementHint: Move it with right-click → «Move the enlarged image».
PCP.Reset.Title: Reset the module
PCP.Reset.MenuHint: Returns the module to its default configuration in case something breaks. Asks for confirmation.
PCP.Reset.Explain: Deletes the module's configuration in this world (party, positions, sizes, bars, look, enlarged view…) and leaves it as freshly installed. It does not touch your characters or anything in Foundry.
PCP.Reset.Confirm: The current module configuration will be lost and replaced by the default one. Continue?
PCP.Reset.Personal: Also reset my preferences in this browser (accessibility, presets, windows)
PCP.Reset.Done: Party Corner Portraits +: original configuration restored.
PCP.Hover.ApplyLook: Apply the look to the enlarged image
PCP.Hover.ApplyLookHint: The same transparency, halo, rotation, flip and black and white the portrait has in the bar (set in the Portrait studio).
PCP.Hover.UpscaleHint: Off, the image is never drawn larger than its file and stays sharp. On, it reaches the chosen size even if it softens.
